items:
~ WHY YOU WILL LOVE “STAY COOL ON 30A” ~
• Only 600 feet to Ed Walline Beach Access
• Seasonally heated community pool just outside the front door
• Prime location directly on Scenic Highway 30A
• Ocean views and a private rooftop terrace
• Steps to Gulf Place Town Center shops & restaurants
• Walkable to coffee, dining, ice cream, and live music
• Spacious townhome with 4 bedrooms & 4 bathrooms
• Easy beach access—ideal for families and multi-generational groups

~ THE SPACE ~
Welcome to “Stay Cool on 30A,” a comfy yet chic coastal townhome perfectly positioned along Scenic Highway 30A. With ocean views, effortless beach access, and walkable dining and shopping, this home offers the ideal blend of convenience, comfort, and coastal charm.

This spacious townhome spans three interior levels plus a private rooftop terrace and comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests. Each bedroom features its own wall-mounted TV and DVD player, allowing everyone to unwind in their own space.

The first floor includes a guest bedroom with a queen bed and twin bunk beds, styled with a modern palm motif, along with a private bathroom. A full-size washer and dryer are also located on this level, along with access to the one-car garage for storing beach gear. Guests may park one additional vehicle in the driveway or on the neighborhood street with a parking permit. At least four beach chairs are provided for guest use.

The second floor is the main living level, featuring a bright and inviting living room with ample seating, a flat-screen TV, books, and games. Just down the hall is a guest queen bedroom and a full hall bathroom with a tiled shower. The fully equipped kitchen offers granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and everything needed for meals at home, including a refrigerator with ice maker, dishwasher, flat-top stove, microwave, coffee maker, toaster, blender, Instant Pot, and Crock Pot. Guests can gather at the island with seating for four or the dining table that seats six.

The third floor features two private master suites, each with a king bed and en-suite bathroom. One suite offers peek-a-boo Gulf views with calming coastal décor, while the other includes double vanities and a walk-in closet accented with stylish navy tones.

A spiral staircase leads to the fourth-floor rooftop terrace, one of the home's standout features. This private outdoor space offers ocean views and is perfect for morning coffee, evening cocktails, or card games under the stars.

Outside, guests can enjoy the back deck with a gas grill and small dining set, along with a grassy area just beyond—great for kids to play safely. The Summer Place community pool is located just steps from the front door and is gated and seasonally heated.

~ THE AREA ~
“Stay Cool on 30A” is located in one of the most walkable and vibrant areas along Scenic Highway 30A. Guests are steps from Gulf Place Town Center, home to local boutiques, coffee shops, restaurants, live music, and seasonal art events. Popular nearby dining favorites include The Perfect Pig, Pizza by the Sea, and Pecan Jacks ice cream shop. “Stay Cool on 30A” is close to multiple public beach access points, including Fort Panic, Dune Allen Regional, West Allen Loop, and Ed Walline Regional Beach Access only 600 feet away. Ed Walline is a local favorite, offering restrooms, parking, and direct access across the street from Shunk Gulley—perfect for grabbing food and drinks to enjoy on the sand while taking in breathtaking Gulf views.

Just minutes away, Blue Mountain Beach—the highest elevation point in South Walton—offers scenic beauty and a laid-back coastal vibe with beloved local spots such as Blue Mountain Bakery, Blue Mabel, and the must-visit Blue Mountain Creamery. Art lovers can explore the bold, textured works at Justin Gaffrey's Studio, while nature enthusiasts will appreciate nearby access to the Longleaf Pine Trailhead and Grayton Beach State Park, spanning over 15,000 acres of protected land with hiking trails, coastal dune lakes, wildlife viewing, and some of the most pristine beaches on the Emerald Coast.
